title.en: Moonshot makes Kimi K3.1 Pro weight files public
title.zhHans: 月之暗面公开 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重文件

searchSummary.en: An independent November 5 report dates open-weight availability to November 4; public Hugging Face files confirm the later weight stage.
searchSummary.zhHans: 11 月 5 日的独立报道将权重可用日期指向 11 月 4 日；Hugging Face 公开文件确认了后续权重阶段。

summary.en: Europa Press reported on November 5 that Moonshot’s Kimi K3.1 Pro weights had become available on Hugging Face the preceding Wednesday, November 4. The public Moonshot repository now contains a model card, license and 96 weight shards. Repository creation on November 2 does not prove when the files first became publicly downloadable. The model-specific license requires an additional commercial agreement for Model-as-a-Service businesses above US$20 million in rolling annual revenue; company benchmark numbers are not independently reproduced here. This is distinct from Vercel’s October 23 hosted gateway access.
summary.zhHans: Europa Press 于 11 月 5 日报道，月之暗面的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重已在前一天（11 月 4 日，星期三）于 Hugging Face 可用。公开仓库现有模型卡、许可和 96 个权重分片。仓库于 11 月 2 日创建，不能证明文件从何时起可供公众下载。专用许可规定，过去连续 12 个月合计收入超过 2000 万美元的模型即服务企业须另签商业协议；本轮未独立复现厂商跑分。这与 Vercel 于 10 月 23 日提供托管网关访问是不同阶段。

narrative.en: November 4 is the date attributed by Europa Press, not independently reconstructed from first-download logs. Hugging Face corroborates present file availability. The license is not an unrestricted MIT grant for all commercial hosting; published weight shards are not proof of external deployment or benchmark leadership.
narrative.zhHans: 11 月 4 日依据 Europa Press 报道，而非通过首次下载日志独立还原。Hugging Face 证实当前文件可获取。该许可并非对所有商业托管一概适用的不受限 MIT 授权；权重分片存在也不能证明外部部署或跑分领先。

text.en: Europa Press dated the Kimi K3.1 Pro weight availability to November 4; public model files and license confirm a weight stage distinct from October hosted access.
text.zhHans: Europa Press 将 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重可用日期指向 11 月 4 日；公开模型文件与许可确认这是区别于 10 月托管访问的权重阶段。

text.en: The model-specific license requires certain Model-as-a-Service businesses with more than US$20 million of rolling annual revenue to obtain a separate commercial agreement; the first public download minute is unknown.
text.zhHans: 专用许可要求过去连续 12 个月收入超过 2000 万美元的部分模型即服务企业另签商业协议；首次公开下载的具体时间不明。
